steps.title: Analyze Video Pause Issue
steps.description: Identified conflicting JavaScript video listener hooks that were forcefully pausing secondary HTML5 media elements on YouTube playback state changes.

steps.title: Refine JavaScript Video Bridge
steps.description: Removed destructive video pausing logic and enhanced media event bridge to prevent videos from pausing immediately on play.

steps.title: Optimize Audio Focus Handling
steps.description: Updated BackgroundAudioService audio focus listener to handle transient ducking without pausing active YouTube media playback.

steps.title: Update Background Session State Verification
steps.description: Refactored background transition methods to preserve active player state when switching apps or locking the device.

steps.title: Verify Manifest & Permissions
steps.description: Validated media playback foreground service configurations and notification permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building BG Tube Player
steps.description: Final compilation and verification of BG Tube Player build artifacts.
